meta.title: AVATAR LIVE — Your VRChat avatar, straight to your stream
meta.description: A Windows app that lets you use your VRChat avatar as it is for streaming, screen sharing and video creation, without VRM conversion. Your original shaders, PhysBones, Expressions menu and face tracking, just as they are.

features.title: The avatar you know from VRChat, just as it is.
features.sub: No need to rebuild anything. Everything built into your avatar moves just as it is.

items.title: No VRM conversion
items.body: Export once from your avatar project and you're done. If you change the avatar, just export it again.

items.title: Your original shaders
items.body: Shows the shaders on your avatar, such as Poiyomi and lilToon, just as they are.

items.title: PhysBones and menus as they are
items.body: Swaying hair, outfit toggles, even expression buttons move with the same settings as in VRChat.

items.title: Face tracking
items.body: Expressions, gaze and even fingers with a single webcam. Uses your avatar's VRCFaceTracking setup as it is.

items.title: Keyboard · mouse hand motion
items.body: Even when your hands are out of view, the avatar's hands move with your typing and mouse. The characters you type are not recorded.

items.title: Streaming and screen sharing
items.body: Send a transparent background to OBS, and the game and your avatar on one screen to Discord.

how.title: Three steps are all it takes.

steps.title: Open your Unity project
steps.body: Open the Unity project (2022.3.22f1) of the avatar you upload to VRChat.

steps.title: Export with the Exporter
steps.body: Create a .vavatar file with a single click in Curious Bobby - Avatar Exporter.

steps.title: Start in AVATAR LIVE
steps.body: Open the file and turn on your webcam, and your avatar moves right away. From then on, you don't need Unity.

how.note: VRM or .vrca files alone can't be used. You need the avatar's Unity project.

showcase.title: Everything you need to stream, in one place.

rows.title: Pick an avatar and start
rows.body: Choose a recently used avatar, or drag and drop a file. Lighting and camera are remembered for each avatar.

rows.title: Your Expressions menu as it is
rows.body: Press the same menu you used in VRChat. Items you use often can become buttons or hotkeys.

rows.title: Tracking that fits your face
rows.body: Make the expressions as guided, and the tracking automatically adjusts to fit your face.

rows.title: Pull it, pose it
rows.body: Grab hair or a tail with the mouse and pull, then pose it in exactly the shape you like.

rows.title: To OBS and call apps
rows.body: Send a transparent background over Spout2, and appear on Discord · Zoom through the virtual camera.

rows.title: Game + avatar to Discord
rows.body: Share the game screen with your avatar on top, without OBS. Your friends see the game and your avatar, and you see only the game.

rows.title: Lighting and camera
rows.body: Change the mood with a single preset, and add backgrounds and effects.

compare.title: No conversion, so it stays just as it is.

items.q: Can I use my VRChat avatar as it is?
items.a: Yes. Export it with the Exporter from the Unity project you upload to VRChat, and the Expressions menu works just as in VRChat — right down to your outfit and accessory toggles. Shaders and PhysBones come along as they are.

items.q: Do I need a Unity project?
items.a: You need it once, to create the avatar file (Unity 2022.3.22f1). After that, you use Avatar Live without Unity.

items.q: Can I use just a VRM file?
items.a: Not at the moment. Support for loading VRM files is planned.
Your avatar's own shaders are shown as they are. We have tested more than 200 shaders, including Poiyomi and lilToon.

items.q: Can I screen share on Discord without OBS?
items.a: Yes. Turn on screen share and choose 'Avatar Live Share Output' in Discord, and the game and your avatar are shared together.

items.q: What's the difference between Basic and Pro?
items.a: Basic is the edition for personal use (including private Discord sharing with friends), and Pro is for streaming, publishing videos and commercial use. Pro offers 4K output, no watermark, posing and objects.
